items.title: Claude skills stay current
items.text: Ghoztty now refreshes its Claude skills and hooks when it starts, so they always match the version you have installed instead of staying at whatever version first wrote them.

items.title: Old plugin leftovers clean themselves up
items.text: An old ghoztty Claude plugin install that no longer works is removed automatically through Claude's own uninstaller, along with its retired marketplace, so it can't block Ghoztty's own skills. A plugin that still works and that you chose to keep is left alone.
